name: Datashaper Ardent Dragon
text:
2 Level 8 Cyberse Monsters
This card cannot be destroyed by battle with a Special Summoned Monster. Once Per Turn (Quick Effect): You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card, target one monster on the field, banish it until the End Phase. If this card is sent to the GY, you can target 1 'Datashaper' monster and 1 'Datashaper' Spell card in the GY add those cards to your hand.
